relationships.subject: S100A8/A9
relationships.evidence_quote: This study showed that S100A8/A9 bound to TLR4 and increased the expression of MMPs, TNF-α, and IL-6 through NF-κB signaling pathways in NP cells.

relationships.subject: S100A8/A9
relationships.evidence_quote: In NP cells, S100A8/A9 increased MMP-3/13, TNF-α, IL-6 expression and inhibited aggrecan and collagen II expression.

relationships.subject: NF-κB signaling
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological inhibition or siRNA knockdown of the NF-κB signaling attenuated S100A8/A9-induced upregulation of MMP-3/13, TNF-α and IL-6.

relationships.subject: S100A8/A9
relationships.evidence_quote: In vivo, S100A9 inhibitor treatment inhibited disc-puncture induced IVDD and inflammation-related pain.

key_findings: S100A8/A9 binds TLR4 and, via NF-kB, increases MMP-3/13, TNF-alpha and IL-6 in nucleus pulposus cells.
S100A9 inhibitor reduced disc-puncture IVDD and inflammation-related pain in rats.
